Drafting a tweet under 270 characters to announce the blog post on AI coding agent costs.

Drafting a friendly, emoji-free tweet with one punchy line about the unexpected daily cost. Checking character count against the 270 limit.

Settled on a draft that frames the measurement as a messy bill covering tokens and retries, with a direct link to the post title.

Revised the draft to highlight quiet costs like retries and long sessions. Added a single 📊 emoji.

Finalized the tweet to 179 characters. It frames the post as a real-week cost tally and a receipt, not a myth.

Switched the emoji to 💸. Replaced the contrastive "less myth, more receipt" with an affirmative tone.

The final tweet is 196 characters. It pairs the tally with a single 📊 emoji.
